selectedGroups.reason: After migrated fleets reopen, timed-out written model/account discovery retains pooled Codex app-server process pairs. selectedGroups.status: integrated-compatible-adaptation; see coordinated PR for final-head proof

selectedGroups.status: integrated-compatible-adaptation; see coordinated PR for final-head proof
